title: CenterPoint Energy, Inc. to Host Webcast of Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about CenterPoint Energy, Inc.,'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
Houston, TX, Sept. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- CenterPoint Energy, Inc. (NYSE: CNP) has scheduled a conference call for Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 7:00 a.m. Central time or 8:00 a.m. Eastern time, to discuss Third Quarter results. Earnings will be released on the same day before the market opens.


CenterPoint Energy will provide a live audio webcast of the conference call, which can be accessed at[CenterPointEnergy.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=u9Gy5tjaoKjIBVwtFdEXS05mhD1_8EUqoAQteeI_S1-9aMcJBu5UxT_YRA2MY2th_CiGK9kN2ZjPqtEoFCT7lk5BZGZ7osJXKUU92YKXEKnBty35miEmQC194ZQKX8b_) . Click on “Events & Presentations” and the link, “CenterPoint Energy, Inc. Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call Webcast.” The webcast will be archived on the company’s website for at least one year.


**CenterPoint Energy, Inc.**


**Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call**


**Tuesday, October 27, 2026**


**7:00 a.m. Central / 8:00 a.m. Eastern**


**About CenterPoint Energy**


As the only investor owned electric and gas utility based in Texas, **CenterPoint Energy, Inc. (NYSE: CNP)** is an energy delivery company with electric transmission and distribution, power generation and natural gas distribution operations that serve more than 7 million metered customers in Indiana, Minnesota, Ohio and Texas. As of June 30, 2026, the company owned approximately $48.3 billion in assets. With approximately 8,800 employees, CenterPoint Energy and its predecessor companies have been in business for more than 150 years. For more information, visit[CenterPointEnergy.com.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=u9Gy5tjaoKjIBVwtFdEXS05mhD1_8EUqoAQteeI_S19ZFY5lnq0S0ZyJf-teb6I-dI1q493w_2g-Aw0zmauGuJm9o_zLfpGhJHcg6qesQ2UTAEONBpn8HlB42mIuKj8uF8uGAsT8H3BKheVNol8JzQ==)
